_about: Inputs to the intelligence-per-megawatt index (AI Economy → Compute; server/intelligencePerMw.js). The index multiplies a model's Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index by the output tokens per second a chip serves it at, per megawatt of provisioned data-centre power. Throughput is SemiAnalysis InferenceX; scores are Artificial Analysis (live from the AI pulse cache, with the snapshot below as a fallback); chip board power comes from gpu-econ.json where it is already kept, and from the `chips` block here for the systems that table does not cover. Facility power per GPU = board power × system factor × PUE (PUE from gpu-econ.json). Editable; the panel prints the reviewed date.

assumptions.floorNote: Tokens per second per user (P90) every operating point must deliver. Throughput per GPU rises as more users share it and each gets slower; the floor fixes the service level so chips are compared on equal terms.
assumptions.frontierBandNote: The headline index counts only frontier-class models: those scoring at least 75% of the smartest model benchmarked by then. Without it a small model wins on sheer volume (gpt-oss-120b, scoring 11.6, serves six times the tokens of models scoring 30-40), and a megawatt of cheap tokens is not a megawatt of intelligence. The bar rises as better models arrive.
assumptions.systemFactorNote: Server power per GPU over board power: CPUs, memory, NICs, switches, fans. 8-GPU boxes run about 1.8x (DGX H100 10.2 kW for 8 x 700 W; DGX B200 14.3 kW for 8 x 1,000 W); NVL72-class racks about 1.4x (GB200 NVL72 roughly 120 kW for 72 x 1,200 W). Provisioned (nameplate) power, because a data centre buys its megawatts at nameplate.

agentic.label: Agentic traces
agentic.note: Replayed coding-agent sessions: long, growing contexts, multi-turn. Covers the newest models and rack-scale systems (GB200, GB300, Vera Rubin).

chat.label: Chat (1k in, 1k out)
chat.note: Single-turn, 1,024 tokens in and out. The longest history (from December 2025), but InferenceX's rack-scale chat runs carry no per-user speed, so GB200 and GB300 drop out.
